thesis: GMAB is an extended post-gap rerating (+68% in 63 days, +127% off the low) being bought into a risk-off tape with VIX in its 99th percentile. The latest two-day bounce (+6.4% on 11-24) has no identified catalyst and is not volume-confirmed, so it looks like a relief rally inside a 50-60 range. First resistance at 59.97 is only about 1R from entry, which leaves the quoted 2.9 R/R dependent on a breakout that may fail. Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 48.4, forward 35.8) with earnings growth negative and debt of 5.198B, and the gap leaves an air pocket down to the mid-40s if the October story, possibly M&A-related and unverified, fades.
